question: On the original 2023 Shaddam Corrino IV Leader, what two alternative benefit branches does Emperor of the Known Universe offer when Signet Ring is used on an Agent turn? State what is gained in the first branch and what must be paid and gained in the other branch. May both branches be taken from that activation?
expected_answer: Choose one branch: gain 1 Solari and recruit 1 troop, or pay 3 Solari to gain 1 Influence with any one Faction. The OR makes these alternatives, so the same activation does not grant both. The recruited troop goes from your supply to your garrison and cannot be deployed that turn because the printed deployment restriction already applies. The restriction timing is existing coverage, not the novel claim.

source_references.region: Lower-right Emperor of the Known Universe ability: first icon group (1 Solari and one troop), OR, then 3 Solari arrow to one freely chosen Faction Influence. Approximate image bounds x=448..641, y=387..421 in the 778x448 image.
